method: Frames at 0s, 1s, 2s and 3s were extracted with ffmpeg from the 360x640 video files the Meta Ad Library served on 2026-11-15. On-screen text was transcribed verbatim from those frames. Audio was not reviewed. 'overlay' is text that stays on screen; 'captions' holds the caption or changing text visible at [0s, 1s, 2s, 3s], with null where there was none. Four frames per second of video can miss caption words shown between samples. 'partial': true marks videos where the sampled frames only caught fragments of the opening line.
